propositions: Batch-path verdicts systematically carry confidence=0.0 because the batch entry JSON schema had no required fields for confidence, candidate_id, and relation, causing them to be omitted and defaulting to 0.0, below the 0.7 threshold needed for aggregate to surface findings.

Output token limit was flat 1024 sized for single verdicts, truncating real multi-candidate batches (K up to 20, producing 10-pair batches with 100+ tokens per entry) and causing the entire batch to be rejected and abstained.

The batch entry contract required changes to make candidate_id, relation, confidence, and abstain mandatory (with shared_artifact remaining nullable) to ensure the model emits valid multi-entry JSON with proper confidence scores per entry.

Output budget must scale with batch cardinality (256 + 192*n tokens for n candidates, measured from real ~230-byte/~65-token entries) instead of a flat 1024, while retaining structured_retry_limit=0 and transport_attempt_limit=1 to prevent retry storms.

Near-duplicate pair detection failed silently for 2,093 plan reviews because single-candidate unit tests stayed green while the batched production path was broken, with zero overlap findings ever surfaced despite the feature consuming ~13% of LLM usage budget.
